itens.trecho: "Paddington" é daqueles que permaneceu durante anos na minha watchlist, mas só recentemente é que o decidi assistir, numa experiência que se revelou bastante positiva. Desde o primeiro momento, fui cativado por esta produção leve e perfeita para descontrair, seja sozinho ou em família.

I loved the optimistic notion of "Aunt Lucy" when she convinces the young "Paddington" to travel from darkest Peru to London safe in the knowledge that the wartime spirit will soon see him adopted by a loving family and bathing in a sea of marmalade!

Keeps getting funnier each time I see it. The kind of perfect family film that has something for all ages, not just kids. There is plenty of sly adult humour that isn't dodgy, and enough slapstick so the kids will laugh at the silly bear's antics. On top of that it is well animated, and full of heart. 8/10
